tips.title: Morning Photonic Reset
tips.advice: View 10-15 minutes of direct sunlight within 60 minutes of waking.
tips.scientific_rationale: Suppresses remaining melatonin and sets the circadian timer for nighttime sleep pressure.

tips.title: Thermoregulatory Drop
tips.advice: Maintain bedroom ambient temperature between 18°C and 20°C (65-68°F).
tips.scientific_rationale: Core body temperature must drop 1-2°F to initiate and sustain deep non-REM restorative sleep.

tips.title: Digestive Buffer Zone
tips.advice: Finish last caloric intake at least 2.5 to 3 hours before sleep.
tips.scientific_rationale: Late gastric motility keeps nocturnal resting heart rate elevated and suppresses growth hormone release.

tips.title: Vagal Downregulation
tips.advice: Practice 4-7-8 breathing or physiological sighs for 4 minutes before lights out.
tips.scientific_rationale: Engages the parasympathetic vagus nerve, reducing autonomic arousal and sleep latency.
